topic: Using Mutex for Thread Safety in C
explanation: A mutex, or mutual exclusion lock, is a synchronization mechanism in C that ensures only one thread can access a shared resource at a time. It is used to prevent race conditions in multi-threaded programs, where multiple threads might interfere with each other when modifying shared data, thereby maintaining data integrity and avoiding errors.
